channel.title: LoomSci - Quantum Physics
channel.description: Latest Quantum Physics articles from LoomSci

item.title: When Chaos Hides Order: The Secret Life of Quantum Entanglement
item.description: Quantum chaos in many-body systems hides a hierarchical entanglement structure, where only a tiny Schmidt sector carries the response to a local quench.

item.title: When Quantum Error Correction Learns to Delegate
item.description: Automated predecoders triage quantum error syndromes, handling over 90% of faults before they reach the main decoder, enabling scalable fault-tolerant quantum computing.

item.title: When a Quantum Simulator Decides to Freeze
item.description: By steering a quantum simulator into the many-body localized phase, researchers transform random walks into disciplined searches for optimal solutions.

item.title: When Quantum Keys Meet a Sweeping Searchlight
item.description: A wide-spectrum testbench reveals hidden vulnerabilities in quantum key distribution systems, closing the Trojan-horse loophole.
